title: Multiplayer cursor mockup collage
summary: A one-word-at-a-time sentence on white while named cursor tags draw frames that fill with device mockups; the collage collapses to a sphere, a dark mark beat, staged phone shots, a gallery that scatters and stacks, then a quiet end card.
use_when: A design or mockup tool that wants to show many polished outputs in 30 s
Products with real-time collaboration where named cursors are part of the story
A silent autoplay launch on a light canvas with one dark brand interlude
You have 10 or more finished renders or screenshots to show as a gallery

look.type_style: medium grotesk, sentence case and lowercase, normal tracking, small: about 4 % of frame height, centred; no display sizes anywhere

sfx.event: cursor tag lands and draws a selection frame
collage cards converge into a stack
sphere wipe into the dark mark beat
gallery bursts outward through the camera
button press by the hand cursor

structure.shot: one word, black, small and centred on white, swapped for the second word at 0.50; two named cursor tags (blue, green) enter from corners dragging thin blue selection frames
structure.motion: words appear by hard swap, no entrance (f0, f15); cursor tags slide in on springs.ui ~12 fr (overshoot not measurable), frame corners trail the arrow; top-left frame fills with a cloud image at 0.77 (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: two-word phrase; four corner frames fill with mockups (laptop, phone, dark poster); a third pink tag draws a frame bottom-left; text tints teal then blurs out
structure.motion: phrase grows by its second word at 1.77; frames fill by hard image swap one every ~0.25 s; tags fade at 2.27; phrase blur-out easings.inExpo ~8 fr at 3.00 (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: one word (fourth step of the sentence) centred, six mockup tiles around the edges: laptop on rock, phone lock screen, chat UI, laptop on stool
structure.camera: push-in on the tiles 1.00 -> 1.08 over 30 fr, centre word unscaled
structure.motion: tiles drift outward then inward, easings.inOutSine; word fades at 4.27

structure.shot: the six tiles converge into one overlapping stack at centre, shuffle order, then fold into a small multicoloured blob
structure.motion: converge with springs.heavy ~20 fr (±0.25 s); reorder 1 swap per 0.25 s; collapse easings.inExpo ~12 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: blob resolves into a lit sphere on white that darkens to navy, shrinks and drifts right; a big blue sphere edge sweeps in from the right
structure.motion: sphere scale 1.00 -> 0.45 over 30 fr easings.outQuint, drift right ~12 px/fr @1920 with motion blur at 6.77; blue disc wipe from right edge ~6 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: white mark centred on a deep-blue swirling mesh gradient; wordmark slides out of the mark at 8.00; gradient heats to cyan, pink and orange at 9.27
structure.camera: slow rotation of the gradient, ~6 deg/s; mark static
structure.motion: wordmark reveal by mask-wipe left to right ~8 fr, mark shifts left to recentre the lockup (springs.ui); colour shift 9.00 -> 9.50 easings.inOutSine

structure.shot: phone standing on a dark rock, black void; small lighting panel with one slider top-left; 2-frame duotone (cyan/orange) flash at the cut
structure.motion: duotone frame 9.57 -> 10.00 then clean; a blue cursor tag enters from the right at 10.27, springs.ui (overshoot not measurable)

structure.shot: same rock and phone, the screen now a bright green payment app; the cursor tag drags the lighting slider and the rock light shifts; tag then moves to the rock
structure.camera: drift: slight orbit, phone rotates ~10 deg over 90 fr; at 13.50 the frame becomes a rounded card on white
structure.motion: tag to slider at 11.77, drags slider 0.10 -> 0.85 between 12.00 and 13.27 easings.inOutSine; rock highlight follows; card shrink starts 13.50 springs.cameraOut

structure.shot: the scene as a rounded card shrinking on white, then a duotone cyan version of the same mockup at 14.77
structure.camera: pull-out: card width 0.86 -> 0.48 of frame over 23 fr
structure.motion: card shrink springs.cameraOut ~20 fr with motion blur on the first 4 fr; duotone swap by hard cut at 14.77 (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: macro of a phone screen corner (green payment app) framed inside a soft green glow backdrop
structure.motion: framed image in a blurred backdrop of its own colour; no in-animation, the cut is the change

structure.shot: tall card: phone with an events app standing on dark rock, pink and blue rim light on a grey backdrop
structure.motion: same framed-image grammar, 15 fr hold

structure.shot: phone corner close-up with a white app screen on a blue-violet and white blurred backdrop
structure.motion: same framed-image grammar, 15 fr hold

structure.shot: tall card of glowing blue mark tiles cascading diagonally on deep blue
structure.motion: static image; glow halo around the card; 4-frame white flash into the next row

structure.shot: that card shrinks onto a white canvas while about 12 more mockup cards fly in from the edges
structure.camera: pull-out 1.00 -> 0.40 on the first card over 10 fr
structure.motion: cards fly in with motion blur, springs.heavy ~20 fr, stagger ~2 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the cards settle into a gallery grid (4 columns, mixed heights) inside an app window with a left sidebar
structure.motion: grid holds; one card swaps at 18.77

structure.shot: the grid explodes toward camera: cards scale up and pass the lens with heavy horizontal blur
structure.motion: easings.inExpo, motion blur on every card, white frame at 19.77

structure.shot: about 9 small mockup cards float on white, drift, then converge into one overlapping stack at centre that drops out the bottom
structure.motion: drift 20.00 -> 21.00 easings.linear; converge 21.00 -> 21.50 springs.heavy; stack bobs at 21.77-22.27; drops off bottom easings.inExpo ~8 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: one blue rounded button with a one-word action label centred on white; a hand cursor presses it
structure.motion: hand cursor enters at 22.77 springs.ui; press at 23.00: button dims to 0.6 opacity and squash springs.click; back to full at 23.50

structure.shot: small black closing line naming the tool (3 words) centred on white, then the black mark alone
structure.motion: hard swaps: line 23.77 -> 25.27, mark 25.27 -> 26.50; no entrance animation

structure.shot: the URL alone, small black type centred on white, held to the end
structure.motion: appears by hard swap, holds 92 fr

params.content.sentence: 4 steps of one sentence, 1-2 words each, swapped in place (word, word, two words, word)
params.content.cursors: 2-3 collaborator names with tag colours (blue, green, pink)
params.content.mockups: 10-13 finished mockup images (phones, laptops, posters), each with its dominant colour for the backdrop
params.content.heroMockups: 2 phone renders for the lighting-slider scene (screen before / after)
params.content.panelLabel: label of the small settings panel with one slider
params.content.button: one-word action label for the pressed button
params.content.close: closing line naming the tool, about 3 words
params.brand: mark, wordmark, accent blue for the gradient interlude and the button

notes: Silent reference: sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Type stays small (about 4 % H) the whole film: the mockups are the picture. Cuts 15.00, 15.47, 15.97, 16.47 come every 14-15 fr. Cuts 15.00-16.47 kept as three rows (each 14-15 fr, above the 6 fr montage threshold). Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): collaborator-cursor-tag, collage-to-sphere collapse. Phones on rocks are pre-rendered images; rebuild with stills, not 3D.
